name: Library and artifacts
why: How a dashboard goes from data to a link you open
ideal: A data change rebuilds a private page within minutes, with one URL per page and a few API requests.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Publish a page from a session (Artifacts)

steps.name: Data
steps.rule: A metrics read makes few API requests.

steps.name: Build
steps.rule: The page builds from the data in one pass.

steps.name: Check
steps.rule: A check reads the built page before it goes live.

steps.name: Publish
steps.rule: A change reaches the published page within ten minutes.

steps.name: Link
steps.rule: Each page keeps one URL and stays private.

steps.name: Refresh
steps.rule: A merge rebuilds the page within a day.
